sentences.text: The respondent no.2 has already undertaken to withdraw the said petition.

6. The respondent no.2 filed a complaint before CAW Cell which culminated into registration of FIR bearing no. 0375/2022 registered under sections 498A/406/34 IPC at P.S. Jamia Nagar wherein the petitioners were implicated.
The petitioner nos.2 to 4 are family members/relatives of the petitioner no.1.
The investigation is still pending and the charge-sheet has not been filed.

The petitioners and the respondent no.2 are identified by their respective counsel as well as by the Investigating Officer,
SI Ramkishore, P.S. Naraina.

7. The petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 vide Settlement Deed dated 06.12.2023 have settled their disputes whereby the petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 have agreed to dissolve their marriage as per the Islamic law.

The petitioner no.1 has also agreed to pay Rs.9,00,000/- along with dowry articles as per annexure A annexed with settlement to the respondent no.2 towards full and final satisfaction of all her claims/legal entitlements (past, present and future) including permanent

The petitioner no.1 has already paid Rs.3,00,000/- to the respondent no.2 which is acknowledged by the respondent no.2.

The petitioner no.1 has also delivered a demand drafts of Rs.1,50,000/- bearing no.056422 dated 13.12.2023 and Rs.4,50,000/-
bearing no. 056423 dated 13.12.2023 drawn on HDFC Bank to the respondent no.2 towards the balance settled amount which is accepted by the respondent no.2.
The marriage between the petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 has already been dissolved according to Islamic Rites and Customs.

8. The respective counsel for the petitioners and respondent no.2 stated that the disputes between the petitioners and the respondent no.2 have already been settled vide Settlement Deed dated 06.12.2023, the terms and conditions of which have already been executed.

The petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 got married on 10.11.2021 as per Islamic law and due to matrimonial differences, they are living separately since 02.03.2022 without any cohabitation.

The petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 have already settled their pending disputes vide Settlement Deed dated 06.12.2023, the terms and conditions of which have already been executed and the respondent no. 2 has already received the amount as per schedule mentioned in Settlement Deed dated 06.12.2023.
The marriage between the petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 has already been dissolved.
No useful purpose shall be served if the proceedings arising out of FIR bearing no. 0375/2022 are allowed to be continued and it would be an exercise in futility.

12. The present petition alongwith pending applications, if any, stands disposed of.
